text: At TWELVE,
this boy LEFT his family behind.
He was POOR, HOMESICK,
and LAUGHED AT for the way he spoke.
But one day, the WHOLE WORLD would know his name.
He grew up on a small PORTUGUESE ISLAND,
in a family that STRUGGLED financially.
His FATHER worked at a local football club,
where the boy fell in LOVE with the game.
At TWELVE, he moved HUNDREDS OF MILES away
to join a football ACADEMY.
He MISSED his family terribly.
Classmates MOCKED his island accent.
But he REFUSED to give up.
Then came another OBSTACLE.
As a teenager, doctors discovered a HEART CONDITION.
After treatment, he RECOVERED
and RETURNED to football.
His dream was STILL ALIVE.
That same boy would win
FIVE BALLON D'OR AWARDS,
FIVE CHAMPIONS LEAGUE titles,
and become one of the GREATEST GOALSCORERS
football has ever seen.
From a SMALL ISLAND,
to the BIGGEST STADIUMS on Earth.
That little boy was CRISTIANO RONALDO.
Never let your BEGINNING decide your ENDING.
